title: Sweep: retro failure identity (14 auditor prescriptions amortised)
summary: Retro/failure-identity prescriptions: fingerprint normalization, escalation hints, failure-digest fidelity. Amortised from 14 content-hash carryoverTodos that were unreachable by any operator directive: their ids were 32-char hashes, so goal-text could never name them and triage could not prioritise them (all 144 were stamped priority=high, which is the same as none being high). Queue audit 2026-08-27. Member prescriptions verbatim below; work them as one sweep, smallest-blast-radius first, and retire the group when the theme is clean.
